messages:
Priya (Procurement): MeterLabs sent a commit proposal. need quick clarity: how do their 'compute credits' map to tokens/embeddings and do unused credits rollover?
Amelia (Finance): also need sample invoice lines for AP parser and preferred payment terms (we prefer net-45 for pilots).
Vikas - MeterLabs: hi team. 1 credit = 1k inference tokens OR 8 embedding units. long-context multiplier applies for requests >2k tokens (1.5x). we can provide token-first pricing if helpful.
Jon S (Eng Ops): our POC used ~1.2M tokens + 40k embeddings; does that map to ~1,200 credits base? what about sequences that hit the multiplier?
Vikas - MeterLabs: roughly yes. multipliers apply per-request at compute time; we include tokens_in/tokens_out in logs so you can reconcile exact billable_credits.
Sasha R (Platform): can you push per-request CSV to our S3? need request_id, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, billable_credits, ts.
Vikas - MeterLabs: yes 96 s3 push or secure link.
Priya (Procurement): rollover options? previous vendor expired everything quarterly and caused headaches.
Vikas - MeterLabs: options: quarterly with 25% rollover or annual with 100% rollover (small maintenance fee).
Amelia (Finance): sample invoice please: commit, used, overage, setup, tax, total. also confirm net-45 for a 3mo pilot.
Vikas - MeterLabs: sample invoice: "Commit Q1 96 150,000 credits @ $0.28 = $42,000; Overage 9,400 credits = $2,632; Setup (VPC) $5,000; Tax $3,150; Total $52,782". net-45 okay for pilot with PO.
Jon S (Eng Ops): any discounted background/spot credits for batch jobs?
Vikas - MeterLabs: yes 96 background credits at 40% discount, tagged in logs and not usable for low-latency routes.
Sasha R (Platform): SOC2 and BYOK for private?
Vikas - MeterLabs: SOC2 Type II yes. BYOK via AWS KMS supported for Private instances.
Priya (Procurement): next steps: 1) Vikas upload full multiplier table + mock invoice CSV, 2) Accounting Bot run parser, 3) Amelia confirm budget, 4) Sasha validate BYOK + background credits. ack?
Amelia (Finance): ack 96 will confirm budget by EOD.
Jon S (Eng Ops): ack 96 will test CSV with our 1.2M token dump.
Sasha R (Platform): ack 96 will validate BYOK path.
Vikas - MeterLabs: I'll upload the table and mock invoice in ~30m and hold a $5k setup concession for 48h. ping me for quick sync. :handshake:
Accounting Bot: ready to parse once CSV link posted 96 will return mapping diffs in ~2hrs.
